title: Compute Per-Embodiment and Transfer Metrics
summary: A single average hides whether a shared policy succeeds only on the embodiment it was trained for.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Rates dimensionless; IDs reference a versioned embodiment registry.

physical_contract.axes: train/test IDs and success(N) -> count/rate(E,E) plus two scalars
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each row is one episode evaluation, not an action timestep; train/test IDs label model-training and deployment embodiment.
physical_contract.batching: train/test IDs and success(N) -> count/rate(E,E) plus two scalars

provenance.authoring_notes: Original cross-embodiment evaluation aggregation inspired by OXE. A matrix cell measures supplied outcomes and cannot prove transfer causality without controlled baselines.
